correctness.rationale: Set n=m+1. For the stated beta-sum C_m, binomial tails give C_m(u,v)=E[min(J_u,J_v)]/n, J_u~Bin(n,u), J_v independent Bin(n,v). For u<=v, M(u,v)-C_m=(1/n)E(J_u-J_v)_+, nonincreasing in v at fixed u, so global max lies on diagonal. Diagonal defect E|J-K|/(2n). Difference of independent paired Bernoullis is a lazy symmetric walk whose number of active steps N~Bin(n,2p(1-p)); conditional E|S_N| nondecreasing as number of steps grows, and 2p(1-p) max at p=1/2. At p=1/2, J-K~Bin(2n,1/2)-n, telescoping central-binomial sum gives E|J-K|=n*binom(2n,n)/4^n. Thus ||M-C_m||∞=binom(2m+2,m+1)/(2*4^(m+1)), global (1/2,1/2) maximizer and asymptotic 1/(2sqrt(pi(m+1))). Independently recomputed exact n=2..8 rational center identities and verified analytic monotonicity; finite grid not used to prove global bound.
